description: Defines the interface for a cookie store in the Chromium networking code, including methods for setting, retrieving, deleting, and managing cookies, as well as callbacks and related classes.

classes.name: CookieStore
classes.description: Interface for storing and retrieving cookies, with methods for managing cookies asynchronously and observing changes.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Sets a canonical cookie asynchronously, with optional access result status.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a URL with specific options asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies asynchronously for management UI.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesWithAccessSemanticsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies along with their access semantics asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAllCreatedInTimeRangeAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies created within a specified time range asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAllMatchingInfoAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching specific info asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteMatchingCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching a predicate asynchronously.

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes the cookie store to disk.

methods.name: SetForceKeepSessionState
methods.description: Prevents session cookies from being deleted on shutdown.

methods.name: GetChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the dispatcher for observing cookie changes.

methods.name: SetCookieableSchemes
methods.description: Resets the list of cookieable schemes.

methods.name: SiteHasCookieInOtherPartition
methods.description: Checks if a site has cookies in other partitions.
